about: The texture factory's materials (tools/textures/). Each id is the key PixelArt and WoodMaterials ask for (PixelArt.factory). metres: the real size the texture covers, [along u (the grain), across v]; texels follow at texels_per_metre (32) a metre. colours: palette size. ref: [painting, x0, y0, x1, y1], a crop of a concept painting shown to the image model for colour and character (never its pixels). boards: the model's board joints are wiped (members are single boards). lightness, contrast, chroma, hue: the judge's corrections on the tiles in Lab (L*, L*'s spread, a*/b*, a turn of a*/b* in degrees). kind: tile (seamless, repeats on members and props), ground (seamless both ways, laid on the ground from above), sign (one whole board with lettering, not repeated). bold: settings for the bold set only (reduce.py --bold, assets/textures/bold/), over reduce.py's BOLD_GRADE. turn: the painting turned a quarter round before it's cut (its grain painted up the picture). flatten: how much of the painting's broad light is divided out (reduce.py FLATTEN 0.3; 1 all of it).

road_wide.what: a long stretch of the dry packed-dirt main street of a frontier desert town seen from directly above, the street running exactly left to right: two pairs of worn wagon-wheel ruts running straight left to right across the whole picture with low ridges of thrown-up dirt along them, hoof prints and boot prints between them, scattered dark stones and pebbles, small clumps of dry yellow grass here and there, warm russet-ochre earth with darker damp patches

road_compact.what: the packed, compacted dirt of a frontier town's main street, beaten smooth and hard by wheels and hooves: broad gently uneven russet-ochre earth, very fine dust over it, a few faint hairline cracks, sparse tiny pebbles; calm and even, no ruts, no tracks, no grooves, no lines
road_compact.about: Roadmap 1.4's road (docs/briefs/road.md): the street's compacted earth, blended with road_loose by the traffic map; the ruts and prints are drawn in code over both. Chroma down 2026-10-16 (docs/briefs/match-the-man.md): the street read saturation 0.69 against the man's 0.52, 'too orange' (critic r3, r4).

road_loose.what: loose, churned dirt of a frontier town's main street where wheels, hooves and boots have broken it up: crumbled clods and lumps, loose crumbs, small clusters of stones and pebbles of many sizes, russet-ochre earth, uneven and broken; no ruts, no tracks, no grooves, no lines
road_loose.about: Roadmap 1.4's road (docs/briefs/road.md): the street's disturbed earth, blended with road_compact by the traffic map. Chroma down 2026-10-16 (docs/briefs/match-the-man.md): the street read saturation 0.69 against the man's 0.52, 'too orange' (critic r3, r4).
